name: Turnip Casserole
description: A savory turnip casserole with apples and a crunchy bread crumb topping, perfect for freezing.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the mashed turnip, pepper, chopped apples (if using), eggs, butter, and salt in a bowl. Mix well.
Transfer the turnip mixture to a buttered ovenproof casserole dish.
Prepare the topping by mixing the bread crumbs with the melted butter until well combined.
Sprinkle the bread crumb mixture evenly over the top of the casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350 °F for 45 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

keywords: turnip casserole, bread crumb topping, savory side dish, freezer-friendly

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Macaroni Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and meat casserole topped with cheese and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 cups grated cheese (e.g., cheddar, mozzarella, Monterey Jack)

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the macaroni, drain and set aside.
Brown hamburger, adding onions, green pepper and mushrooms.
Add the spices, ketchup and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer.
Place the macaroni and meat mixture in a large casserole dish and mix.
Spoon the mushroom soup across the top, covering the casserole.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cover and bake in 350°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, cheesy pasta bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish
